title: The Horse Park at Woodside
specs: Over 270 acres with eight arenas and multiple specialized courses including cross-country and polo
Hosts FEI-level competitions and a broad array of equestrian sports
All horses must be up to date on all vaccinations
No horses from facilities with active or recent strangles cases (within 21 days)
No horses from facilities under state quarantine until 14 days after restrictions lifted
Riders schooling on cross-country course must wear safety helmet and protective vest and be accompanied by a partner over 18 with a mobile phone
Supports multiple equestrian disciplines with resident trainers and events

blurb: The Horse Park at Woodside is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization focused on land stewardship, equestrian education, and sport. It hosts a variety of equestrian disciplines including eventing, dressage, hunter/jumper, reining, vaulting, polo, and more. The facility includes multiple arenas, cross-country courses, and supports competitions, clinics, and schooling.
extraNote: Membership required to use Park facilities unless registered participant or spectator of public competition/special event · Covered arena use prioritized for resident training operations, full-use members, and day-use pass holders during inclement weather · No headsets allowed during allocated covered arena schedule · No lunging or ponying allowed in covered arena during priority use · Cross-country course reservations open one month in advance; if not open, course is closed
